exact_statement: For every positive alpha,beta with irrational ratio, determine whether the multiset of floor(2^s alpha) and floor(2^s beta), s>=0, is complete; also determine the stated variant with 2 replaced by any fixed gamma in (1,2).
scope_notes: Official page checked 2026-08-25: OPEN, zero claimed proofs.
The irrational-ratio hypothesis, the floor rather than ceiling convention, and the separate gamma in (1,2) question are all frozen.
A new bounded parameter region, modular experiment, or precompleteness criterion alone does not close the public statement.
